name: Food Bill Assistance to SC Students
benefit: - The food bill assistance @ ₹1,500/- per month (Up to 10 Months) will be granted to the Scheduled Caste (SC) students admitted in college affiliated hostels.
_eligibility_text:
1.	The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
2.	The students should reside in the hostel, affiliated to the college.
3.	The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹6 lakhs.
